description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Amendment to SLFRS 9 - Prepayment Features with Negative Compensation w.e.f. 01.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the adoption of amendments to the Sri Lanka Financial Reporting Standard (SLFRS 9) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka, as authorized by the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act. It involves the publication of new regulatory requirements and compliance rules for financial reporting, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification for matters concerning regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
